items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: You know, Kelly Martin was with me also with the big band, too, for awhile also before he went with the 'Misty' man.

ctx.x: And then, I made it, I had a couple of changes. Let me see. Norris Turney. I Mercer Ellington now, think he's playing with (unintelligible) first alto.

He took Bobby Smith's place. There were a couple of bass players. I can't recall their name cause Stanfield passed soon. Oh, Kelly Martin. You know, Kelly Martin was with me also with the big band, too, for awhile also before he went with the "Misty" man.
